description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for the MiracastPlayer plugin, including tests for method registration, logging, RTSP communication, and state handling, with embedded RTSP server simulation.

classes.name: MiracastPlayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture for the MiracastPlayer plugin, setting up mock interfaces and plugin initialization.

classes.name: MiracastPlayerEventTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture for testing event-driven scenarios with mock socket server.

methods.name: initialize_ServerSocket
methods.description: Initializes a non-blocking TCP server socket on port 7236 for RTSP simulation.

methods.name: release_SocketDescriptor
methods.description: Closes and cleans up server/client socket descriptors.

methods.name: runRTSPSourceHandler
methods.description: Simulates an RTSP server that accepts connections and exchanges RTSP messages based on provided message buffer arrays.

methods.name: parse_received_parser_field_value
methods.description: Parses CSeq values from RTSP messages.

methods.name: send_rtsp_msg
methods.description: Sends RTSP message over given socket with delay and logging.

methods.name: recv_rtsp_msg
methods.description: Receives RTSP message within timeout, handling errors and logging.
